statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-42245 (GHSA-q2mw-fvj9-vvcw): before net-imap 0.4.24, 0.5.14 and 0.6.4, Net::IMAP::ResponseReader rescans the whole response buffer for every string literal it reads, so a large response with many literals takes quadratic time and a hostile IMAP server can exhaust the client's CPU (a denial of service): https://github.com/ruby/net-imap/security/advisories/GHSA-q2mw-fvj9-vvcw. On the 0.4 release line it is fixed in net-imap 0.4.24, whose release notes name this advisory: https://github.com/ruby/net-imap/releases/tag/v0.4.24. In the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, net-imap ships in the ruby3.3-net-imap package, which is built from the ruby-3.3 source with its own version number; ruby-3.3-full depends on it. We downloaded every published ruby3.3-net-imap package for Alpine 3.23 on x86_64 and aarch64, checked each against its repository index checksum, and compared its installed lib directory with the net-imap release from rubygems.org; each matches its release byte for byte: 0.4.21-r0, 0.4.21-r1 and 0.4.21-r2 install net-imap 0.4.21, 0.4.21-r3 installs net-imap 0.4.24, and 0.4.25-r3 and 0.4.25-r4 install net-imap 0.4.25. Each ruby-3.3 build is built together with the ruby3.3-net-imap package of the same package release (-rN): 3.3.10-r0 to 3.3.11-r2 with net-imap 0.4.21 (ruby3.3-net-imap 0.4.21-r0 to 0.4.21-r2); 3.3.11-r3, which upgrades the bundled net-imap to 0.4.24, with ruby3.3-net-imap 0.4.21-r3; and 3.3.12-r3, 3.3.13-r3, 3.3.14-r3 and 3.3.14-r4, whose Ruby releases bundle net-imap 0.4.25, with ruby3.3-net-imap 0.4.25-r3 and 0.4.25-r4. The published DHI Ruby 3.3.11 and 3.3.12 dev images for Alpine 3.23 install ruby-3.3 3.3.11-r3 with ruby3.3-net-imap 0.4.21-r3 (net-imap 0.4.24) and ruby-3.3 3.3.12-r3 with ruby3.3-net-imap 0.4.25-r3 (net-imap 0.4.25), on amd64 and arm64. The ruby-3.3-libs 3.3.11-r3 package also carries the net-imap 0.4.24 gem archive, identical to the rubygems.org file; ruby-3.3-libs 3.3.11-r2 carries none. So the first published ruby-3.3 build that ships the fix is 3.3.11-r3: the builds before it ship net-imap 0.4.21, and it and every later build ship net-imap 0.4.24 or 0.4.25.
